RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a factor that disadvantaged you relative to the person hired. While an all-male panel may reflect a broader lack of gender diversity within the municipality's leadership, raising it will not help your case and risks appearing adversarial or misplaced. 

The hiring decision likely hinged on non-technical factors, such as the panel prioritizing public consultation experience, political acumen, or interview rapport over formal credentials and municipal tenure. Instead of questioning the panel's composition, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can better align your profile with municipal leadership priorities for future opportunities.
